_comment: Consistency pass. Groups files (mostly by directory — peers that SHOULD look alike), derives each group's dominant pattern programmatically, and flags deviations. Inconsistency = distance from your own norm. Agents only judge whether a deviation is meaningful drift vs an intentional exception.

layeringRules.name: web-bypasses-context
layeringRules.message: Web layer should call domain contexts, not Repo directly (skips tenancy/validation).

layeringRules.name: core-imports-web
layeringRules.message: Core/domain modules should not depend on the web layer (inverts the dependency arrow).
